Title: LSJ: Is Cleave stackable during a single strike?

Messages.Author: d21...@yahoo.com.au
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Probably a dumb question but I thought to get it confirmed anyway.

Can I play more than 1 Cleave for a single strike?

Messages.Author: Klai...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Yes all cards stack by default and nothing in cleave says that it
wouldn't. And also note that cleave is in effect the whole combat, not
just one strike.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
d21...@yahoo.com.au wrote:
> Can I play more than 1 Cleave for a single strike?

You can play more than one choosing the same weapon, sure.
Or play one as a weapon and play some more to increase the damage done
by that weapon.
